file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) console executable, MinGW-w64 GCC 13, stripped

injection_details.method: VirtualAlloc(NULL, 0x40, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE=0x3000, PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE=0x40) -> memcpy decrypted shellcode into buffer -> CreateThread(start=buffer) -> WaitForSingleObject(5000 ms) -> CloseHandle (function 0x14000188b)

injection_details.payload_written_by: memcpy (msvcrt) of the in-place RC4-decrypted payload into the RWX allocation
